notes.title: Bug Fixes and New Quests
notes.content:
We’ve made some exciting improvements to enhance your experience!

🆕 Updated Game Icon – Enjoy our brand-new, refreshed icon!

🗺️ 15 New Daily Quests – Dive into fresh challenges and expand your adventure.

🧱 Object Placement Fixes – Fixed incorrectly placed objects for smoother gameplay.

notes.title: Now Live:New Gear, Pool, Custom Rooms & More
notes.content:
Latest Update: New Features & Improvements!

🖱️ New Gaming Gear

Stylish keyboards & mice added to enhance your gaming setup!

Upgrade your desk with sleek, new gaming chairs and desks for maximum comfort.

🎵 Studio & Music Equipment

We’ve expanded the studio options with new microphones, sound panels, electric guitars, drums, and more! Perfect for any aspiring musician or content creator.

🎨 New Wall Paints & Flooring

Freshen up your space with vibrant new wall colors and stylish parquet flooring options.

🏞️ Local Rugs & Decor

Add personality to your rooms with unique Yin-Yang rugs, plants, wall hangings, and other custom decor items.

🏊‍♂️ Pool Now Functional

Your pool is now open for swimming once unlocked! Cool off and enjoy the water in style.

🍽️ New Dishes Added!

A variety of new dishes are now available in the restaurant. Enjoy a broader menu!

🧹 Bug Fixes & Optimizations

Fixed broken assets and enhanced performance for a smoother gameplay experience.

Receptionists can now kick out 'illegal' customer types.

Resolved VIP invitation crash bug.

Fixed object color issues.

🛏️ Design Your Dream Room

Now you can design your own custom room with a bed, toilet, shower, and faucet.

Press “T” to copy your room data and share it with us on Discord – we might just add it as a template in the game! (https://discord.gg/ChtTM8Npvx)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164015/7d0c77c0090629d34bec1b5972aed7580003c29b.png[/img][h1]Update Notes:[/h1]

Stretching no longer causes discomfort while designing rooms; the stretching mechanic has been improved.

New template rooms have been added.

Controller usage has been made more intuitive.

New objects have been added.

Minor bugs in hotels have been fixed.

New songs have been added for the cleaner character.

[h2]Share Your Room with Everyone![/h2]

If you design your own room and meet the required conditions (a closed room with a bed, toilet, shower, and faucet), you can press the "T" key to copy your room data.

Then, simply send that copied data to us via Discord.
If everything looks good, we’ll do our best to include it as a template room in the game!

Let your creativity be part of the game!

notes.title: 🎉 Hotel Owner Simulator is OUT NOW! 🛎️
notes.content:
[h3][b] It’s time to unlock the doors and welcome your very first guests![/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=DMLoeFaoiXk;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re beyond excited to finally share the full version of Hotel Owner Simulator with you. Start from the ground up and build your dream hotel empire — design every room, negotiate prices, expand floor by floor, and manage it all your way.

From sketching out room layouts wall by wall to turning a small hotel into a luxurious business, this game is all about creativity, strategy, and a bit of hustle. 💼

🚪 Whether you're a perfectionist builder or a tycoon in the making — your hotel journey starts today.

Thank you for being with us through wishlists, playtests, feedback, and support. Now go and make those guests happy... or at least charge them well. 😉

Let us know what you think — and don’t forget to leave a review!
 💬 We’re listening, and we’ve got more updates planned.

👉 See you in the lobby!

notes.title: Full Release Coming May 8, 2025 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

We’re beyond excited to finally announce that [b]Hotel Owner Simulator will officially launch in its full version on May 8, 2025![/b] 🎊 After a ton of feedback, polishing, and love from the community, we’re ready to open the doors wide and let you dive into the full hotel management experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158480/Hotel_Owner_Simulator/

If you've played the early version, you already know the basics - designing every room from scratch, adjusting layouts, placing walls, setting prices, and keeping those guests happy. But the full version takes it all further: more features, more freedom, and way more opportunities to grow your hotel empire one floor at a time. 🏗️

Whether you’re a perfectionist decorator, a business-minded negotiator, or just someone who loves watching a small idea turn into something huge - this is your time to shine.
We seriously can’t thank you enough for all the support, bug reports, ideas, and good vibes you’ve sent our way so far. ❤️

Let’s build, manage, and make something amazing.
[b]May 8th - mark your calendars.[/b] Your hotel empire is waiting. 🏨💼
